title: Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build
title_zh: 价值观塑造自我改进编程智能体构建的方案
abstract_en: Self-improving agents are typically optimized for the results they produce, with less attention to how they produce them. Their instructions give designers limited ways to shape how they work, especially when the task is open-ended. This paper studies whether a short value statement in an agent's persistent instruction file changes not only how well the agent performs but also what it builds. Four higher-order value types in Schwartz's theory of basic human values were evaluated: openness to change, conservation, self-enhancement, and self-transcendence. Across diverse coding tasks, the values were held fixed within each run over multiple iterations of self-improvement. Three findings emerged: (1) Values matter for performance across a diverse set of tasks. The openness values increase performance on held-out data, whereas the opposite conservation values result in scores below those of an agent given no values. (2) Values change what agents build, producing solution algorithms that differ in size, complexity and approach. (3) Human oversight is still needed for designing values. Allowing the agent to revise its own values narrows the differences between sets of values, and values distilled from the AI literature provide no detectable gain over having no values. Properly designed values can thus influence what a self-improving coding agent builds and, where the task permits, how well it performs.
abstract_zh: 自我改进智能体通常围绕产出结果进行优化，而设计者较难通过指令约束其求解方式，尤其是在开放式任务中。本文研究：在智能体的持久指令文件中加入简短的价值观声明，是否不仅会改变其表现，也会改变它构建的方案。实验基于 Schwartz 的基本人类价值观理论，比较了四类高阶价值观：开放求变（openness to change）、保守维持（conservation）、自我提升（self-enhancement）和自我超越（self-transcendence）。在多种编程任务中，每次运行都经历多轮自我改进，期间保持价值观设定不变。结果显示，开放求变提高了留出数据上的表现，而保守维持的得分低于未设定价值观的基线。价值观还改变了所生成算法的规模、复杂度和求解思路。让智能体自行修订价值观会缩小不同设定之间的差异；从 AI 文献中提炼的价值观相较于无价值观基线也未带来可检测的增益。研究表明，经过人工设计的价值观能够引导智能体构建不同的方案，并在部分任务中改善表现。
key_points_zh: 将简短的价值观声明写入持久指令文件，并在每次运行的多轮自我改进中保持设定不变。
开放求变提高了留出数据上的表现，保守维持的得分则低于未设定价值观的基线。
价值观不仅影响分数，还改变生成算法的规模、复杂度和求解思路。
智能体自行修订价值观会缩小不同设定间的差异；从 AI 文献提炼的价值观未带来可检测的增益，凸显了人工设计与监督的重要性。

llm_assessment.comment: The study shows that fixed value prompts can change what self-improving coding agents build, but it offers no new mechanism for improving those agents.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 研究表明固定的价值观提示会改变自我改进型编码智能体产出的方案，但没有提出新的智能体改进机制。
